state.seed_assertion: In most cases, a data controller can consider that a processing meeting two criteria would require a DPIA to be carried out.

sentences.1: In most cases, a data controller can consider that a processing meeting two criteria would require a DPIA to be carried out.
sentences.2: In most cases, a data controller can consider that a processing meeting two criteria would require a DPIA to be carried out.
sentences.3: In some cases, a data controller can consider that a processing meeting only one of the high risk criteria requires a DPIA.
sentences.4: However, in some cases, a data controller can consider that a processing meeting only one of these criteria requires a DPIA.
sentences.5: In case the processing concerns personal data that has not been obtained from the data subject and the information to be provided to data subjects pursuant to Article 14 of GDPR proves impossible or would require a disproportionate effort or is likely to render impossible or seriously impair the objectives of the processing.
sentences.6: A DPIA is compulsory if a processing operation meets at least two of the eleven specified criteria, in addition to cases provided in Article 35(3) GDPR and taking into account the exception in Article 35(10) GDPR.
sentences.7: In addition to the cases provided for in Article 35 (3) GDPR, and taking into account the exception provided for in Article 35 (10) GDPR, carrying out a DPIA shall be compulsory if the processing operation meets at least two of the following criteria
sentences.8: The list of processing operations subject to DPIA is not exhaustive and does not remove or alter the obligation to conduct a DPIA in all cases where the conditions of article 35 par.1 of GDPR are met.
sentences.9: Meeting just one of the nine high-risk criteria could require a DPIA in one's specific case.
sentences.10: you may consider in your case that just meeting one criterion could require a DPIA.
sentences.11: In most cases, a data controller will require a DPIA when processing meets two of the criteria listed in the WP29 DPIA Guidelines, but in some cases, the WP29 DPIA Guidelines considers that processing meeting only one of these criteria requires a DPIA.
sentences.12: The Guidelines on DPIA sets out criteria to consider in determining processing operations likely to result in a high risk, and in most cases, a controller can consider that processing meeting two criteria would require a DPIA to be carried out.
